consumerContracts.CS: Full authored curve domain and whole named target-plane UV; retain only authored lift P(T), every T root and every target-plane UV. Include contained, singleton and complete-empty controls.
consumerContracts.SSI: Full authored source and whole named plane in both source orders, then the declared closed quarter-box; retain every original UV and incident.
consumerContracts.B: Actual exact validated face, authored directed outer unit rectangle and inner [1/4,3/4]^2; all three policies; actual SSI and F(t,1/2) queries. The selected oracle is raw equality AND winding membership at every target preimage.
consumerContracts.S: Complete ordered D x D, original equality, minus authored diagonal and only the explicit scoped structural relations. Retain both material tuples when trimmed.
consumerContracts.I: The explicitly declared period/collapse/join or authored identity, restricted to both half-open scopes; symmetry and same-intermediate-owner composition. False boundary, foreign frame, crease and disjoint-scope controls are mandatory.
consumerContracts.X: Complete retained result through ordinary and prepared public entry, all XYZ/source tuples, rank-defined image/fiber strata and every integer cycle. No finite window substitutes for an infinite family.

completion: Complete independent selection iff on every terminal cell; source/role/guard negatives; exact N/N-1 resources; entry/mid/final/empty/query cancellation; detached/COW lifetime; fixed Native/ASAN/WASM/Embedded; one review and finding-only confirmation; coherent commit and latest-main delivery.
ownership: Definitions only. PROGRESS.md alone owns execution and completion state. Static gaps are not reproduced runtime failures. Catalog presence accepts no implementation.
